title: 군표창규정 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 7 (Authorities Competent to Confer Commendations)
(1) Citations and award certificates shall be presented by the President, the Prime Minister, the Minister of National Defense, the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, the Chiefs of Staff of the respective armed services, and the heads of units or departments prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of National Defense. <Amended on December 31, 1992; September 19, 2017>
(2) Deleted. <September 19, 2017>
(3) Certificates of appreciation shall be presented by the Minister of National Defense, the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, the Chiefs of Staff of the respective armed services, and the heads of units or departments prescribed by Ordinance of the Ministry of National Defense. <Amended on December 31, 1992; September 19, 2017>
(4) Citations from the President and the Prime Minister under paragraph (1) shall be presented in accordance with the Regulations on Government Commendations. <Amended on December 31, 1992; January 16, 2013>
